21892.title: Dragon platebody
21892.wikitext:
{{Otheruses|the armour piece|the joke item sometimes referred to as the dragon plate|Spinning plate}} {{External|rs|dw=Dragon Platebody}} {{Infobox Item |name = Dragon platebody |image = [[File:Dragon platebody.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2018]] |update = Dragon Slayer II |aka = DPB |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = Provides excellent protection. |value = 2000000 |weight = 11.339 |exchange = Yes |id = 21892 |leagueRegion = Fremennik&Misthalin }} [[File:Dragon platebody detail.png|left|150px]] The '''dragon platebody''' is an armour used in [[melee]] and the strongest of all standard [[Platebody|platebodies]]. It requires 60 [[Defence]] and completion of the [[quest]] [[Dragon Slayer I]] to equip. It offers some of the highest [[bonuses]] of any non-degradable armour in the game, providing higher slash and stab defence than the [[Bandos chestplate]]. For melee use it is a direct upgrade to the [[dragon chainbody]] in every stat except crush, with the chainbody having +1 crush defence more than the platebody. Despite its high defensive bonuses however, the dragon platebody lacks a strength bonus, making it less commonly used for general melee training. Players with level 90 [[Smithing]] can make one by using a [[dragon chainbody]], [[dragon metal lump]], and [[dragon metal shard]] at the [[Dragon Forge]], granting 2,000 [[experience]]. This variant of the '''Torva platebody''' is an unobtainable version of the regular [[Torva platebody]], which resembles its appearance prior to the 3 August 2023 graphical update.

The [[Torva_armour#Appearance|graphical update to Torva armour]] was done with the reasoning that it was not "consistent with Old School's art style", and a non-trivial number of players disagreed with said change, mostly due to nostalgia towards its iconic appearance in its original release in ''RuneScape 2'' in 2011.

As such, this item was released as a compromise to allow the third party client [[RuneLite]] to use the assets for various plugins which changed the appearance of the player character (such as [https://runelite.net/plugin-hub/show/fashionscape Fashionscape] and [https://runelite.net/plugin-hub/show/weapon-animation-replacer Weapon/Gear/Animation Replacer]), although other players would not be able to see said player overriding their appearance.
